turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - alloy_pair_target_train.csv: 300 samples described by composition in wt% — C, Mn, Si, Cr, Ni, Mo, V, Nb, Co, Al, Ti, Cu
      (Fe is the balance: Fe = 100 − Σ of the others) — plus processing parameters
      (solutionizing_temp, aging_temp, aging_time, cooling_rate) and categorical
      settings heat_treatment (annealed | quenched | quench_temper | solution_aged)
      and route (cast | wrought | AM), with the measured 0.2 % proof yield strength in MPa (the `target` column).
  - alloy_pair_target_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE recipes whose yield strength was NOT measured, with the same columns plus `candidate_id` and no `target`.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have a yield strength CLOSEST to 1051 MPa — not the highest, the closest to that value — then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904, c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training targets reach a maximum of only ~908 MPa (with the next-highest values at ~899 MPa and ~864 MPa). Consequently any candidate whose composition + processing vector lies extremely close to one of those three high-strength training points will receive a k-NN / tree-based prediction near that high value and will therefore be the closest to the (unobserved) target of 1051 MPa.

Four pool recipes are near-duplicates of those high-strength examples (identical heat-treatment/route, aging temperature within ~20 °C, aging time within a few hours, and all twelve alloy contents within a few tenths of a percent):

- c079 reproduces the 908 MPa point (quench-and-temper, AM, Co–V–Cu-rich),
- c017 reproduces the 864 MPa point (quench-and-temper, wrought, moderate Ni–Cr),
- c008 and c033 both reproduce the 737 MPa point (quench-and-temper, cast, high-Cr low-Ni).

A fifth recipe, c039, is an equally tight match to a 721 MPa quench-and-temper wrought example. All other pool members sit farther from every training point whose measured strength exceeds 700 MPa and therefore receive substantially lower predictions.

Hence the five candidates ordered by predicted proximity to 1051 MPa are c079, c017, c008, c033, c039.

Final: c079, c017, c008, c033, c039
